answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Work waits on the sonnet until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the plume of the next round. Reaching the kernel of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, held in escrow until finality, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain.
